response.question_summary: Relative angle ½(π/4)t² = 2π → t = 4 s, key correct.

reports.evidence: Dots realign when the relative angle is 2π: ½(π/2 − π/4)t² = 2π → t² = 16 → t = 4 s (both blind solves). At t = 2 s the relative angle is only π/2.
reports.student_reply: The dots line up again when the faster wheel is one full turn (2π) ahead: ½ × (π/4) × t² = 2π gives t = 4 s. At 2 s it's only a quarter-turn ahead.
